evidence.description: Missing or unparseable month keys produce Date.distantPast and an empty report object.
The month is committed before the report's throwing conversion completes.

candidates.explanation: latestMonth is assigned before the throwing serialization and decoding of latestReport. If either operation fails, the method throws but retains the new month alongside the old report. An empty or unrecognized response can also assign Date.distantPast before decoding fails.
candidates.title: Failed decoding leaves partially updated report state

evidence.description: Month keys are parsed to dates, then reconstructed using the single-digit month format before dictionary lookup.

candidates.explanation: The code discards the original month keys and reconstructs the selected key by formatting its parsed date. Date parsing can accept representations different from the formatter's output, such as a zero-padded month. A key such as "2023-06" can therefore be reformatted as "2023-6", causing the lookup to miss an existing report and substitute an empty object.
candidates.title: Reformatted dates may not match original response keys

evidence.description: The response-key formatter has no explicit locale or calendar before parsing the supplied keys.

candidates.explanation: The formatter used for response keys specifies a date format and time zone but leaves its locale and calendar at their defaults. Consequently, the year and month in machine-readable keys can be interpreted using user-specific calendar settings rather than a stable calendar, affecting both the stored date and the displayed report month.
candidates.title: Machine-readable month parsing depends on user settings

evidence.description: The response is discarded and the returned body is immediately parsed without checking HTTP status.

candidates.explanation: The fetch ignores the response metadata and treats any returned body as report data. URLSession does not inherently throw for HTTP error statuses, so an error response with a compatible JSON body can update the report, while other error bodies surface as unrelated serialization or decoding failures.
candidates.title: HTTP response status is discarded
